releases.name: opencode-pi-intercom 0.3.0
releases.body:
**OpenCode V2 support** — the package now serves both plugin generations from one entrypoint.

- **Dual V1+V2 entrypoint**: default export carries a V2 definition (`opencode.pi-intercom` + `setup()`) alongside the V1 `server()` function; V2 (`plugins` key) and V1 ≥ 1.18.29 (`plugin` key) each load their own path. Older V1 releases keep working via the named `IntercomPlugin` export. Verified end-to-end on OpenCode v2.0.16 (broker registration, `intercom` tool, injected ask → agent run → auto-reply).
- **V2 adapter** (`src/v2.ts`): maps the V2 plugin context onto the harness-agnostic `SdkClient` boundary — `ctx.session.prompt` for injections, `ctx.session.synthetic` for `noReply` messages, `ctx.session.switchModel` for `bridgeModel`, `ctx.session.context` for assistant text, `ctx.model.default()` for the model label, `ctx.event.subscribe()` for session tracking. Broker core unchanged.
- **V2 tool registration** via `ctx.tool.transform` with plain JSON Schema; invalid tool actions return an error string instead of throwing.
- **V2 event normalization** (`normalizeV2Event`): `session.execution.started` → busy presence, `session.execution.succeeded/failed/cancelled` → idle + auto-reply trigger, `session.step.started` → live model label.
- **Model label fix**: unwraps the `{ location, data }` envelope from `ctx.model.default()`.
- **Reload-safe lifecycle**: init guard resets on unload/failed setup/disabled plugin, so config-triggered reloads reinitialize the broker; registrations disposed on cleanup.

`npm i opencode-pi-intercom@0.3.0` · 58 tests (45 existing + 13 new)
